JSZip 3.10.1 is vendored from the supplied QuestionBridge attachment, which already bundled it for offline operation. CalendarBridge, QuestionBridge, and SyllabusBridge now use this single minified copy. The original copyright and MIT/GPL dual-license notice remains at the top of jszip-3.10.1.min.js. No CDN request is needed at run time. The larger unminified copy supplied in SyllabusBridge is the same JSZip version; ZIP round-trip behavior is covered by the browser checks.
